description: Powered by the flagship Snapdragon 8 Gen 5 on advanced 3nm technology, iQOO 15R is the fastest smartphone in the segment, delivering top-tier performance, ultra-fast memory, and flagship-level speed for gaming and multitasking. The iQOO Supercomputing Chip Q2 enables the most stable 144FPS in gaming with 1.5K Game Super Resolution, while a dedicated Network Enhancement Chip delivers 20% lower cellular latency for smoother, more responsive gameplay. OriginOS 6.0 brings a fast, refined user experience with seamless cross-device connectivity, long-term software support with 4 years of OS updates and 6 years of security updates, and easy data transfer from Android or iOS. India’s slimmest smartphone in 7600mAh battery, iQOO 15R charges rapidly with 100W FlashCharge and stays cool with advanced bypass charging. It has a 50MP Sony OIS camera with smart AI features, IP68/IP69 durability, and a vibrant 1.5K 144Hz AMOLED eye-care display with 5000 nits local peak brightness for a complete flagship experience.
